PlayerKarteaSessionCsvDAO

class PlayerKarteaSessionCsvDAO[source]

Bases: BaseCsvDAO[PlayerKarteaSession]

DAO of PlayerKarteaSession in CSV.

All sessions of a player are stored in {player_id}_{sanitized_name}_kartea_session.csv, one row per session, with an incremental id. The CRUD lives in BaseCsvDAO.

Attributes:
modeltype, class attribute

Summary model for Kartea player session data.

suffixstr, class attribute

“kartea_session”.

player_daoPlayerCsvDAO

DAO for accessing Player objects.

sessionsdict[int, PlayerKarteaSession]

Sessions by id (the same dictionary as cache).
